title: Log in with a wizard already made, play it and stand in Ravenwood
notes: The run seeds its account's one wizard before the client starts: a Fire wizard in WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood,
named from the install's own name tables and dressed in a look the client's own creation screens wrote.
The client lists it, and the run presses Play; the client's own -C option is not used, because it asks the
server to create a wizard from a bare name rather than choosing the one listed.
The login server hands the client to the scratch game server, which spends the key, loads the wizard,
puts it in the zone's public instance and sends MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE with its object; the client loads the
zone and says so with MSG_CLIENTZONED, which is when the wizard stands in the world.
The login server starts before the game server has extracted the creation tables and announced its
realm, so its two warnings about both being empty are expected here.
Entering the world, the client asks for its timed access passes and subscriber-only items, says it is done
shopping and reports its screen, which 4.12 answers and the run checks, before it says it has loaded the zone.
It also asks for its buddies, mail, ladders, subscriptions, tutorial log and more, and sends its first move;
later milestones answer those, and until then each is reported once by the game server and listed below.
It then waits for the client's next keepalive on the game server, so a session closed after the wizard
stands fails the run rather than passing it; a message the server does not handle yet spends the drop budget
only the first time a session sends it, so the chatter above fits the shared default.
The login server's DEBUG line for MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3 shows the client's version, revision, locale and machine
decoded field by field, which the run records.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server decodes the authentication message field by field
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made
the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the wizard on the character selection screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server sends the wizard its object
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the client loading the zone
the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in Ravenwood
the game server answers the timed access passes
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked for its timed access passes and was told it has none

steps.name: the game server answers the subscriber-only items
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked which items only subscribers may use and was told none

steps.name: the game server takes the end of shopping
the game server takes the screen the client runs at
the wizard is still connected at the next keepalive
the wizard still standing
the client loaded every object the server sent
steps.pattern: LoadObject Failed|LoadObject tried to read more data
